sources.name: Local owned or licensed assets
sources.notes: No third-party source assumption; local license evidence needed.

sources.name: Kenney
sources.license_hint: Many official asset pages are CC0; verify each individual pack.
sources.notes: No automatic download; trademarks and third-party content still require care.

sources.name: OpenGameArt
sources.notes: Choose and record the license for the actual asset.

sources.name: Game-icons.net
sources.notes: Author credit and license link must be recorded.

sources.name: Lospec
sources.license_hint: Different tools and palettes carry different rights.
sources.notes: Palette database is not a blanket asset license.

sources.name: Godot Asset Store
sources.license_hint: License varies by asset and plugin.
sources.notes: Plugin software licenses must be checked independently.

sources.name: Godot Asset Library
sources.notes: Legacy discovery; verify compatibility and terms.

sources.name: Freesound
sources.notes: API permissions are separate; M0.9 never calls API.

sources.name: itch.io assets
sources.notes: Purchase and download rights are not presumed.

sources.name: Mixamo
sources.license_hint: Service-specific terms, not a general SPDX grant.
sources.notes: Standalone redistribution blocked; game embedding requires human review.

sources.name: ThreeJS Assets
sources.license_hint: Per-asset Free/Premium commercial license: end-product embedding; no standalone file redistribution.
sources.notes: API downloads require scoped account key. Public previews are not licensed downloads. M1.4 is offline and must not auto-download.
